classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish the curved boundary from the complete boundary of a sector using labelled radii and an arc.

inlines.text: Describe the difference between the arc length and the perimeter of a sector.

spec.description: Unshaded sector with its centre at the lower-right vertex, a horizontal radius extending left, a radius extending upper-left, and a curved left boundary. Both radii are labelled r and the arc is labelled l.
spec.mathematics: Both straight boundaries are radii of the same circle. The connecting curved boundary is the arc. Geometry is schematic; no numerical radius or angle is given or printed.
spec.answerVisibility: All three boundary labels are permanent student-visible givens. No answer is drawn.

answer.short: Arc length is $l$. The perimeter includes the arc and both radii: $l+2r$.
answer.worked:
The arc length $l$ measures only the curved boundary. The perimeter measures the entire outside boundary, including the two radii:
$$\begin{aligned}P&=l+r+r\\P&=l+2r.\end{aligned}$$
